purpose: Additional independent link-level tuning, acceptance and final evaluation after optimization
development_note: All 12 previously observed episodes are now training data; their former holdout is no longer used for confirmation.

measurements.rtt_jitter_loss: 100 ICMP probes at 20 ms spacing; RTT mean and population stddev
measurements.utilization: measured source veth TX bytes / actual elapsed interval / capacity; not VPP
measurements.raw_counter_audit: per-frame TX counter before/after, elapsed seconds and configured Mbps

fresh_collection.split_rule: whole chronological episodes; all WANs together; no cross-episode windows
fresh_collection.acceptance: at least 2% MAE gain, >=3 episode groups, >=30 windows, paired episode-block 95% CI upper<0

search.linear_features: current level plus relative lag1/lag3/mean, stddev, observed slope*30; training-only standardization
search.selection: minimum tuning MAE only; ties prefer smaller weight then linear before trees in declared order
search.acceptance: untouched chronological acceptance; >=2% MAE reduction, >=3 episode groups, >=30 samples, paired episode-block bootstrap 95% CI upper<0
search.rejection: use persistence; do not try another candidate on acceptance
search.holdout: report only after selection and acceptance are frozen; no retuning

acceptance_rejection: Do not choose another candidate after viewing acceptance. Reject each failed metric to persistence.
final_evaluation: Report all final episodes and metrics after parameters and gate are frozen. No retry based on final performance.
scope: ICMP/UDP through isolated Linux veth/NetEm, no flexiEdge/VPP/overlay or ISP circuits
